prompt: A tester finds a crash in the checkout flow. Which GitHub surface should carry the report?
explanation: Issues track work: they carry assignees, labels, milestones, and cross-references, and they close when the fixing pull request merges. Discussions hold ideas; gists and wikis hold content.

options.text: An issue — the trackable unit of work for bugs and tasks
A discussion — the place for open-ended conversation
A gist — the place for sharing code snippets
A wiki page — the place for documentation
